text: Soon after Helen left, a huge man burst into our room, and he was so tall that his hat almost touched the top of the door. <break time="0.8s" /> I am Doctor Grimesby Roylott of Stoke Moran, he shouted, I know my stepdaughter has been here, so stay out of my business. <break time="0.8s" /> To show his strength, he picked up the iron poker from the fireplace, bent it with his huge hands, and threw it down. <break time="0.8s" /> When he had gone, Holmes only laughed, picked up the poker, and with a sudden effort straightened it again. <break time="0.8s" /> That afternoon Holmes studied the will of Helens mother, and he found exactly what he had expected to find. <break time="0.8s" /> If both daughters had married, the doctor would have lost a large part of his yearly income. <break time="0.8s" /> He has a very strong reason to stop them from marrying, said Holmes, We must go to Stoke Moran today. <break time="0.8s" /> At the old house, Holmes found that nobody could have opened the shutters of Julias room from the outside. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the room he noticed a thick bell rope above the bed, but when he pulled it, it did not ring at all. <break time="0.8s" /> The rope was attached to a small ventilator, which opened not to the fresh air outside but into the doctors room next door.
